Mixer 0.11.0

- New Settings window: gear button at the top, File > Settings, or Ctrl+comma
- Interface size 100, 125 or 150 percent, and the grid on or off
- Touchpad mode: two-finger scrolling turns the view (Shift slides, Ctrl zooms)
- Zoom toward the mouse pointer, invert zoom, and turn speed
- Auto-save every few minutes (on by default, every 5 minutes)
- Undo steps, recent projects, start window on or off, default export format and scale

If you have Mixer 0.10, the Mixer Launcher offers this update by itself: press Update now.
